features.name: has_counterargument_comment
features.definition: Does the discussion have at least one counter-argument comment in the supplied comment list?
features.spec: Parse OC_comments as a JSON list. Return 1 if the list has at least one entry (len>0), 0 if it is a valid empty list, null if missing or malformed. Raw count of list entries only; no semantic filtering.

h0: has_counterargument_comment has no association with the probability of delta.
h1: Rows with has_counterargument_comment=1 have a higher probability of delta than rows with 0.
note: "Logged counterargument" is interpreted as a counter-argument comment present in OC_comments. Inspection showed every one of the 2,000 rows has at least 1 comment (min length 1), so the feature is constant in this corpus. It is perfectly collinear with the intercept, so no coefficient can test the claim; term=null. No absent-comment group exists, and no substitute such as comment count is used. The feature is raw-text based and comments may contain outcome announcements.
